name: Insider
tagline: Insider is a unified customer data and experience platform that uses AI to personalize marketing across web, mobile, email, SMS, and push channels. Its Sirius AI enables predictive segmentation, journey orchestration, and content optimization to drive conversions and customer lifetime value.
